summary: Wire Bayushi Kahoku - exp (personality-wave-24) on two generalized primitives. P1: a Ranged/Melee Attack-vs-Followers exception (AttackFollowerException) covering printed-on-ability (unconditional, Reconnaissance-gated, target-status-gated), source-scoped static traits (Kahoku), and grants by another card (Yoritomo Ebumi). P2: a declarative any-of target-status predicate (TargetStatus: honorable/dishonorable/keyword/Clan/Clan-or-keyword) as an effect condition (IfTarget) and a legality layer (TargetMustBe); Dispensing Justice, Winds of Dismissal, Isawa Mitsuko - exp and the non-experienced Kahoku migrated, fixing Shadowlands-as-keyword-only cards. Six Personalities published: Kahoku - exp, Tsuruchi Kosoko - exp, Yoritomo Ebumi, Kakita Kazan, Hiruma Nitani, Kuni Shinoda - exp. The lane is shared only because each published card ships its standard per-wave card-face JPG under src/L5R.Client/Content/Published (the shipped scan art, no client code or UI change); every code change is authoritative rules engine in L5R.Core.
validation: dotnet run --project tests/L5R.Core.Tests: 207/207 core, 57/57 published, gold/deck suites green; bash tools/check.sh --skip-client: all requested checks passed. 12 hand-applied mutations of the new code were each killed by at least one new test. Scans of all six cards read by eye against catalogue stats/keywords/text. PublishedTests pinned count recomputed from origin/main (390) + 6 = 396.
remaining: OPEN RULES QUESTION (decision point AttackComparedForce): for a Personality with Followers targeted under an exception, is the Attack's strength compared to his OWN Force (wired, provisionally, literal reading) or the whole unit's Force total? Unwired family members: Strategic Strike (needs a latent Strategy-stays-in-hand fix on the deferred-Attack path plus a strategy wave), Toritaka Chokichi (needs a Follower Performer category), Ikiryo (needs last-attached-to tracking), Bayushi Shibata - exp (needs a timed province-strength modifier). See docs/decisions/2026-09-18-attack-followers-exception-and-target-status.md.
